description: P&L metrics per cost center and period across the full history, paginated over cost_center via after_cost_center and pagination.next_cursor (with categories each row counts several times against the page budget; the response states the weight). Amounts are result effect (revenue +, expense −). `revenue` is the sum of all labels in the tenant's revenue group; sales deductions and penalties booked on revenue-group labels are already netted in. include_categories=true adds the split per label (category_totals), and revenue is then the sum of the revenue-group categories. granularity quarter, year or total returns the finished rolled-up figures. available_range gives the overall time range. Hidden cost centers stay included and are marked as hidden on each row. Every number in cost_centers must be a known cost center (unknown numbers are rejected); a known cost center without P&L bookings in the range is listed in `warnings`. period_from/period_to must be valid (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD) and period_from must not be after period_to.

after_cost_center.description: Pagination cursor: pagination.next_cursor of the previous call returns the next page

cost_centers.description: Optional cost center numbers; get_cost_center_list maps names to numbers.

granularity.description: Time bucket of the returned figures: 'month' (default), 'quarter', 'year' or 'total'. The tool rolls the months up itself.

include_categories.description: Default false. true adds category_totals (label name → value, revenue +, expense −), category_label_ids (name → ids of the labels summed into it) and category_totals_sort_order to each row; fewer cost centers fit on a page.

metrics.description: Which metrics to return (default: all six)

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

name: aggregate_pnl_by_cost_center
